simple_writer_prompt: Answer the question directly in brief, generated English using the validated quotes. Write one self-contained sentence per item. Every sentence must be fully supported by at least one cited quote on its own. If the answer needs different quotes, use separate sentences instead of combining facts from the quotes. Use the source's subject. Leave out report-attribution phrases such as "the report states" or "according to GAO" unless that wording is part of the quote and is needed to answer the question. Cite the supporting quote IDs in quote_ids. Preserve numeric values, units, actor, conditions, negation, and attribution. Skip unrelated source details and unsupported parts. Return JSON.
